limits: Six cases execute actual service, ownership helper, status/readiness policy and AppError with repository/schedule and generated-enum adapters. No HTTP route, live Prisma, cron parsing or concurrency run.

Equal-status calls retain ownership checks but skip activation-readiness and schedule recalculation. Coarse route permission enforcement is outside this lab. Status update and audit have no enclosing service transaction.
summary: Made equal workflow status requests idempotent by returning after authorization and transition validation without persistence or change audit.
Added actual workflow service runtime coverage for no-op, valid transition, and invalid transition behavior.
